Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) study using the DSSO cross-linker to validate a structural model of Myosin VI. While not a traditional 'enrichment' for a PTM, the use of cross-linkers targets specific residues (K, S, T, Y) and requires a complexome-style analysis (MeroX).

scope: we performed a cross-linking mass spectrometry analysis of the purified FLMyo6 to validate our structural model
